name: Jarvis CoWork — LFM3 (llama.cpp)
description: Start Jarvis's always-on LFM3 1.7B model with llama.cpp (OpenAI-compatible API on port 8080) inside the Linxr Alpine VM. Defaults to the tiny phone-class tier. CoWork approvals stay off this recipe — this is inference only.
author: Whoami / CoWork OS
script:
set -eu
MODEL_DIR=/mnt/sdcard/JarvisModels
MODEL_FILE=LFM3-1.7B-Uncensored-AD-Q4_K_M.gguf
MODEL_PATH=$MODEL_DIR/$MODEL_FILE
IMAGE=ghcr.io/ggml-org/llama.cpp:server
mkdir -p "$MODEL_DIR"
if command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then apk add --no-cache docker docker-cli curl ca-certificates || true; fi
if command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then rc-service docker start || true; fi
i=0; while [ $i -lt 30 ]; do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; i=$((i+1)); sleep 1; done
if ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Docker is not ready. Enable the Docker engine in Linxr and retry.'; exit 1; fi
if [ ! -f "$MODEL_PATH" ]; then
  echo "Missing $MODEL_PATH"
  echo "Copy LFM3-1.7B-Uncensored-AD-Q4_K_M.gguf to Android /storage/emulated/0/LinxrShare/JarvisModels/ then retry."
  exit 1
fi
docker pull --platform linux/arm64 "$IMAGE"
ARCH=$(docker inspect "$IMAGE" --format '{{.Architecture}}' 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)
if [ "$ARCH" != "arm64" ] && [ "$ARCH" != "aarch64" ]; then echo "Refusing image arch $ARCH (need arm64)"; exit 1; fi
docker rm -f jarvis-llama >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
docker run -d --name jarvis-llama --restart unless-stopped --network host --platform linux/arm64 -v "$MODEL_DIR":/models:ro "$IMAGE" -m /models/$MODEL_FILE --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 --alias LFM3-1.7B-Uncensored --ctx-size 8192 --parallel 1
echo 'Jarvis llama-server is starting on port 8080. Open http://localhost:8080 from Chrome on the phone.'
notes: Place LFM3-1.7B-Uncensored-AD-Q4_K_M.gguf in Android /storage/emulated/0/LinxrShare/JarvisModels/ (VM: /mnt/sdcard/JarvisModels/) before deploying. Linxr already forwards port 8080. Open http://localhost:8080 in Chrome. Do not import this as a replacement for the official Ollama recipe — use that path only if you want Ollama on 11434. The 8B model is not started here. CoWork is a later, RAM-heavy opt-in (see deploy/linxr/README.md).
